exam.title: Session 2 — SQL Practice
exam.description: Validated practice set for SQL Command Languages / Session 2, using the production question banks linked to Session2.pptx.

questions.question: Which statement best describes SQL according to the session?

options.text: SQL is a database engine that stores files by itself.
SQL is a query language used to perform operations on data and database objects; it is not itself a database system.
SQL is only a graphical ER-modeling tool.
SQL is a hardware component inside the DBMS.

explanation.ar: المادة بتعرّف SQL كـ Structured Query Language لتنفيذ عمليات على البيانات والجداول، وبتؤكد إنها مش Database System بحد ذاتها.

questions.question: In the session diagram showing how applications communicate with a DBMS, what language is placed between applications and the DBMS?

explanation.ar: في الرسم الموجود في Slide 5، SQL هي طبقة التواصل بين التطبيقات والـ DBMS، وده بيوضح دورها كلغة أوامر واستعلامات.

source.reference: Slide 5 — How to communicate with the DBMS?

questions.question: Which SQL command family contains CREATE?

options.text: None of DDL, DML, or DQL

explanation.ar: CREATE موجودة تحت DDL لأنها بتعرّف أو تنشئ structure جديد في قاعدة البيانات.

questions.question: Which SQL command family contains INSERT?

options.text: None of DDL, DML, or DQL

explanation.ar: INSERT مصنفة في المادة تحت DML لأنها بتضيف data rows داخل جدول موجود.

questions.question: Which SQL command is shown under DQL in the session?

explanation.ar: الـ diagram في Slide 8 بيضع SELECT تحت DQL تحديدًا، بينما ALTER تحت DDL وDELETE تحت DML.

questions.question: What is the main role of DDL as presented in the session?

options.text: Only reading rows without changing anything.
Only inserting new records into existing tables.
Changing the structure of database tables, such as creating, altering, or deleting tables.

explanation.ar: DDL مسؤولة عن Structure: إنشاء الجدول أو تعديل بنيته أو حذف الجدول، مش مجرد تغيير قيم الصفوف.

questions.question: What is the main role of DML as presented in the session?

options.text: Creating and dropping table structures only.
Modifying data in the database through commands such as INSERT, UPDATE, and DELETE.

explanation.ar: DML مسؤولة عن Manipulation للبيانات المخزنة، والمادة بتذكر INSERT وUPDATE وDELETE كأوامرها الأساسية.

questions.question: Which set contains only DDL commands listed in the session?

explanation.ar: القائمة الصحيحة كما وردت في المادة هي CREATE وALTER وDROP وTRUNCATE تحت DDL.

questions.question: Which set contains only DML commands listed in the session?

explanation.ar: المادة بتجمع INSERT وUPDATE وDELETE تحت DML، لأنها أوامر تتعامل مع تغييرات البيانات.

questions.question: According to the session, which statement about DDL transaction behavior is correct?

options.text: DDL commands are auto-committed and their changes are permanently saved.
DDL commands are described as never saving changes.
DDL commands are described as DQL operations.
DDL commands are described as row-only operations.

explanation.ar: حسب صياغة الـ session، أوامر DDL موصوفة بأنها auto-committed؛ السؤال هنا يقيس محتوى المادة كما هو.

questions.question: According to the session, which statement about DML transaction behavior is correct?

options.text: DML commands always delete the table structure.
DML commands are all classified as DDL.
DML commands are not auto-committed and their changes can be rolled back before they are permanently saved.
DML commands cannot change stored records.

explanation.ar: حسب الـ session، DML ليست auto-committed ويمكن rollback للتغييرات قبل تثبيتها؛ السؤال ملتزم بصياغة الملف.

questions.question: Which DDL command is specifically used to create a new table?

explanation.ar: CREATE هي الأمر المخصص لإنشاء Table جديد؛ DROP للحذف وDELETE للصفوف وSELECT تحت DQL.

questions.question: Consider the statement: CREATE TABLE EMPLOYEE (Name VARCHAR2(20), Email VARCHAR2(100), DOB DATE); What operation is this statement performing?

options.text: Creating a new table named EMPLOYEE with defined columns.
Adding a new row to EMPLOYEE.

explanation.ar: الكود يبدأ بـ CREATE TABLE، وبالتالي أثره إنشاء جدول EMPLOYEE وتعريف أعمدته، وليس إدخال records.

questions.question: A company is introducing an AuditLog table that does not yet exist. Based only on the DDL concepts taught in the session, which command is the best choice?

explanation.ar: طالما المطلوب Table جديد غير موجود، الاختيار الصحيح من DDL هو CREATE TABLE.

questions.question: What does DROP do according to the session?

options.text: Adds a new column to an existing table.
Deletes both the table structure and the records stored in the table.
Queries the table without changing it.

explanation.ar: DROP في المادة يحذف الـ structure نفسه بالإضافة إلى الـ records الموجودة داخله.

questions.question: What is the result intended by this statement from the session: DROP TABLE EMPLOYEE;?

options.text: Only rows with a matching condition are removed.
The EMPLOYEE table itself is deleted, including its stored records.
A new EMPLOYEE table is created.
A new column is added to EMPLOYEE.

explanation.ar: DROP TABLE EMPLOYEE يعني إزالة الجدول نفسه؛ ده مختلف عن DELETE اللي يتعامل مع rows داخل جدول موجود.

questions.question: A temporary table is no longer needed at all, including its structure and existing records. Which taught command best matches this requirement?

explanation.ar: لما المطلوب التخلص من الجدول بالكامل بما فيه بنيته، DROP هو القرار المناسب من الأوامر التي تم تدريسها.

questions.question: What is ALTER used for in the session?

options.text: Changing the structure of an existing table, such as adding a new attribute or modifying an existing one.
Adding a new data row only.
Deleting the entire table and all records only.

explanation.ar: ALTER يستخدم لتعديل Structure جدول موجود، مثل ADD attribute جديد أو MODIFY attribute حالي.

questions.question: What does the following statement do: ALTER TABLE STU_DETAILS ADD (ADDRESS VARCHAR2(20));?

options.text: Inserts a student row containing an address.
Adds an ADDRESS column to the existing STU_DETAILS table.
Selects the ADDRESS values from STU_DETAILS.

explanation.ar: صيغة ALTER ... ADD في المثال بتضيف column جديد اسمه ADDRESS إلى الجدول الموجود.

questions.question: An existing Customers table must gain a new LoyaltyCode column without replacing the whole table. Which taught command family and action best fit?

explanation.ar: إضافة Column إلى جدول موجود هي Structure change، لذلك تندرج تحت DDL وبالتحديد ALTER TABLE ... ADD.

questions.question: What is TRUNCATE used for according to the session?

options.text: Adding a new attribute to a table.
Deleting all rows from a table and freeing the space containing the table.
Changing selected existing values with UPDATE.

explanation.ar: TRUNCATE موصوف في المادة بأنه يحذف كل rows من الجدول ويحرر المساحة المرتبطة بها.

questions.question: Which command best matches the goal "remove all rows from EMPLOYEE" while using the DDL operation taught specifically for that purpose?

options.text: ALTER TABLE EMPLOYEE ADD ADDRESS VARCHAR2(20);

explanation.ar: لإفراغ كل rows باستخدام أمر DDL المخصص لذلك في الملف، الاختيار هو TRUNCATE TABLE.

questions.question: Consider: TRUNCATE TABLE EMPLOYEE; Which description matches the session?

options.text: It is a DML command that adds one employee.
It is a DQL command that returns all employee rows.
It is a DDL command that adds a new column.
It is a DDL command intended to remove all rows from EMPLOYEE and free the associated space.

explanation.ar: TRUNCATE مصنف DDL، والأثر المذكور له هو إزالة جميع الصفوف وتحرير المساحة، وليس إضافة أو قراءة data.

questions.question: A staging table must be emptied completely before the next load, but the requirement is not to delete the table definition itself. Which taught command best matches this scenario?

explanation.ar: DROP يحذف الـ table structure، بينما TRUNCATE موجه لإزالة كل الصفوف؛ لذلك السيناريو يناسب TRUNCATE.

questions.question: What is INSERT used for according to the session?

options.text: Inserting data into a row of a table.
Changing the structure of a table.

explanation.ar: INSERT وظيفته إضافة data إلى row داخل table موجود.

questions.question: What is the intended effect of: INSERT INTO javatpoint (Author, Subject) VALUES ('Sonoo', 'DBMS');?

options.text: All rows are removed from the table.
A new column named Subject is added.
A new row with the supplied Author and Subject values is inserted into the table.

explanation.ar: INSERT INTO ... VALUES تضيف row جديد بالقيم المعطاة للأعمدة المحددة.

questions.question: A school registration system needs to add a newly registered student as a new record in an existing Students table. Which taught DML command is appropriate?

explanation.ar: إضافة طالب جديد كـ record جديد هي عملية INSERT ضمن DML.

questions.question: What is DELETE used for according to the session?

options.text: Adding a new column to an existing table.
Removing one or more rows from a table.

explanation.ar: DELETE في المادة مخصص لإزالة row واحد أو أكثر من جدول.

questions.question: What is the intended effect of: DELETE FROM javatpoint WHERE Author='Sonoo';?

options.text: The javatpoint table structure is dropped.
A new Author column is added.
A new row for Sonoo is inserted.
Rows in javatpoint matching Author='Sonoo' are removed.

explanation.ar: وجود WHERE Author='Sonoo' يعني أن الـ DELETE يستهدف الصفوف المطابقة للشرط، وليس Structure الجدول.

questions.question: A table contains several obsolete records identified by a condition, and only those records should be removed. Which taught command is the best fit?

explanation.ar: عندما المطلوب حذف records بناءً على condition، الصيغة التي قدمتها المادة هي DELETE FROM ... WHERE condition.

questions.question: Which command is listed as a DML command even though its detailed syntax is not shown in this session?

explanation.ar: UPDATE مذكور في الـ taxonomy وفي قائمة DML، لكن الملف لا يعرض له syntax تفصيلي؛ لذلك السؤال يختبر التصنيف فقط.

questions.question: An existing customer record contains an old email address that must be changed rather than inserting or deleting the customer. Which DML command named in the session matches that task?

explanation.ar: المادة تذكر updating records كعملية SQL وتضع UPDATE تحت DML؛ تغيير قيمة في record موجود يناسب UPDATE.

source.reference: Slides 6, 8 and 14 — updating records / UPDATE under DML

questions.question: Which comparison correctly distinguishes ALTER and UPDATE based on the session?

options.text: ALTER is DDL for table structure changes, while UPDATE is DML for changes to stored data.
ALTER and UPDATE are both DQL commands.
ALTER inserts rows while UPDATE creates tables.
ALTER deletes rows while UPDATE drops the table structure.

explanation.ar: ALTER يغير table structure، بينما UPDATE ينتمي إلى DML ويستخدم لتغيير البيانات؛ الفرق هو Schema/Structure مقابل Data.

source.reference: Slides 12 and 14 — ALTER vs DML UPDATE

questions.question: A developer first creates a Students table and later adds a student row. Which command pairing correctly matches those two tasks?

explanation.ar: إنشاء الجدول أولًا يحتاج CREATE TABLE، وبعد وجوده إضافة row جديد تحتاج INSERT INTO.

questions.question: Which statement correctly compares DROP and DELETE using the session definitions?

options.text: DROP and DELETE are both DQL commands.
DELETE removes the table structure, while DROP only removes selected rows.
DROP removes the table structure and its records, while DELETE removes one or more rows from a table.
DROP adds columns, while DELETE creates rows.

explanation.ar: DROP يزيل الجدول نفسه مع بياناته، بينما DELETE يزيل rows من جدول موجود؛ لذلك لا يمكن اعتبارهما نفس العملية.

questions.question: A developer needs to remove every row from a table. Which distinction from the session is most relevant when choosing between TRUNCATE and DELETE?

options.text: TRUNCATE is DQL while DELETE is DDL.
TRUNCATE is taught as DDL for deleting all rows and freeing space, while DELETE is DML for removing one or more rows.
TRUNCATE creates tables while DELETE alters columns.
Both commands are taught only as aliases for SELECT.

explanation.ar: المادة تفرق بين TRUNCATE كـ DDL لإزالة كل الصفوف، وDELETE كـ DML لإزالة row أو أكثر؛ ده جوهر الاختيار هنا.

questions.question: How is SELECT classified in the SQL command diagram from the session?

options.text: It is not shown in any SQL command family.

explanation.ar: في Slide 8، SELECT هو الأمر الموجود تحت DQL. الملف لا يشرح DQL بتفصيل أكبر من هذا التصنيف في هذه الجلسة.

questions.question: A developer wants to remove one erroneous record but proposes DROP TABLE Orders. What is wrong with this choice based on the session?

options.text: DROP is only used to query data.
DROP is the same as INSERT.
DROP removes the table structure and its records; DELETE should be used to remove row data.
DELETE is the command for creating tables.

explanation.ar: استخدام DROP لحذف record واحد خطر لأنه يحذف table structure أيضًا؛ المناسب للـ rows هو DELETE.

questions.question: Consider the sequence: CREATE TABLE T (...); followed by INSERT INTO T VALUES (...); How should the two statements be classified?

explanation.ar: CREATE TABLE من DDL لأنها تنشئ structure، وبعدها INSERT INTO من DML لأنها تضيف data.

questions.question: Consider the command sequence: ALTER TABLE T ADD X INT; DELETE FROM T WHERE ...; SELECT ... . Which family sequence matches the session taxonomy?

explanation.ar: ALTER مصنف DDL، DELETE مصنف DML، وSELECT مصنف DQL؛ وبالتالي الترتيب الصحيح DDL ثم DML ثم DQL.

source.reference: Slide 8 with Slides 12 and 16 — SQL command families
